name: What steps are involved in the construction process from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in the construction process from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Construction follows a sequential process designed to build safely and pass inspections at critical milestones. Work begins with site protection and selective demolition, followed by custom framing to establish room dimensions. Next, mechanical trades install rough-in plumbing, electrical, and HVAC components. Once rough-in inspections pass, insulation and drywall are hung, taped, and finished. Finally, the project moves to interior trim, custom carpentry, tile and marble installation, and painting. At HH Remodeling LLC, hands-on oversight guarantees each stage meets strict craftsmanship standards before the next phase begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process follows site prep and demolition, custom framing, mechanical rough-ins, drywall installation, and final interior finishes like trim, tile, and paint.
